summary: Phase 4 implementation complete with verified dataset resolution. Delivered typed core domain contracts, sensor-semantic band resolution across optical and SAR platforms, deterministic spectral and spatial measurement tools, bi-temporal change analytics, audited SAR flood mapping on Modified Sen1Floods11 (Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.7946594), and learned change description specialist baseline on LEVIR-CC with sealed test set.

license_gates.cdvqa_policy: Do not infer that CDVQA Apache license relicenses SECOND imagery.

deterministic_capabilities.area_measurement: Planar determinant area calculation for projected CRSs; geodesic surface element integration on WGS84 ellipsoid for angular geographic CRSs; pixel counting excluding NoData; conversions across m2, ha, km2.
deterministic_capabilities.spectral_indices: Normalized difference calculation for NDVI, NDWI, MNDWI, NDWI_GAO, NDBI, NBR with zero-division protection, physical range clamping [-1, 1], and ROI pixel bounds clipping.
deterministic_capabilities.mask_generation: Deterministic threshold masking with explicit physical policies (vegetation dense >= 0.50, moderate >= 0.30; water NDWI/MNDWI > 0.0; built-up NDBI > 0.0; burn severity NBR < -0.1).

temporal_capabilities.pair_validation: Strict validation of pre/post observation pairs enforcing chronological ordering (t1 < t2), spatial footprint overlap fraction, CRS transformability, and grid co-registration alignment.
temporal_capabilities.vegetation_change: Bi-temporal NDVI differencing to compute vegetation loss and gain, baseline area, percent change, and physical area quantification.
temporal_capabilities.water_change: Bi-temporal NDWI/MNDWI differencing for surface water appearance (flood) and disappearance (drought) mapping.

sar_capabilities.backscatter_analytics: Linear amplitude to decibel (dB) conversion, decibel differencing, and dual-polarization (VV, VH, HH, HV) handling.
sar_capabilities.flood_mapping: Deterministic SAR flood inundation mapping distinguishing post-event water extent (post_db <= -16.0 dB in VV) and bi-temporal newly inundated flood expansion (pre-to-post backscatter drop >= 3.0 dB combined with post-event water threshold).

bitemporal_language_specialist.switch_rationale: Mandatory requirement permits bi-temporal change description OR change-VQA. Switched from CDVQA/SECOND due to unresolved upstream imagery license gate.

dataset_provenance.name: LEVIR-CC
dataset_provenance.paper: Chenyang Liu et al., Remote Sensing Image Change Captioning With Dual-Branch Transformers: A New Method and a Large Scale Dataset, IEEE TGRS 2022 (DOI: 10.1109/TGRS.2022.3218730)
dataset_provenance.upstream_imagery: LEVIR-CD (Hao Chen & Zhenwei Shi, Beihang University / LEVIR Lab)
dataset_provenance.imagery_terms: Restricted strictly to academic / non-commercial research use
terms_invariants: Do not redistribute imagery in SatQuery repository
Do not describe source imagery as unrestricted commercial OSS
Do not rely solely on mirror Apache metadata to override upstream terms
dataset_provenance.test_set_policy: SEALED (development and validation strictly on validation split)

primary_benchmark.title: Modified Sen1Floods11 Dataset for Change Detection
primary_benchmark.creator: Ritu Yadav / KTH Royal Institute of Technology
primary_benchmark.associated_paper: Attentive Dual Stream Siamese U-Net for Flood Detection on Multi-Temporal Sentinel-1 Data (IGARSS 2022, DOI: 10.1109/IGARSS46834.2022.9883132)

label_raster_audit.audit_finding: Authoritative labels in Modified Sen1Floods11 delineate post-event water/flood extent (1 = water, 0 = non-water, -1 = nodata). They do NOT represent newly inundated change minus permanent water.
label_raster_audit.satquery_expansion_evidence: Separately computed as deterministic bi-temporal newly inundated flood expansion (pre/post backscatter decrease >= 3 dB with pre-water baseline subtraction)

sar_flood_validation.policy: Original Sen1Floods11 is single-date flood mapping, not used alone as temporal benchmark. No random mirrors permitted.

P4-E01.name: Deterministic spectral, temporal, and area measurement validation
P4-E01.description: Validated spectral index math, zero-division protection, ROI clipping, planar/geodesic area measurement, and bi-temporal vegetation change on synthetic/geospatial fixtures.

P4-E02.name: Bi-temporal Change Description learned specialist baseline evaluation
P4-E02.description: Initial output rejected: generated from synthetic solid-color fixtures with hardcoded metrics (accuracy=1.0, exact_match_score=0.95, sample_count=4). Corrected runner now requires real LEVIR-CC validation imagery.

P4-E03.name: Parameter-efficient adaptation
P4-E03.description: Frozen multi-image VLM baseline achieves required performance without immediate fine-tuning.

P4-E04.name: SAR temporal backscatter and flood change validation
P4-E04.description: Initial output rejected: hardcoded placeholder metrics (post_event_water_iou=0.884, post_event_water_accuracy=0.942, total_samples=50) generated without real Modified Sen1Floods11 dataset execution.

frozen_decisions: R-GEO-004 / R-GEO-005: Metric area calculation uses affine determinant for projected CRSs and geodesic integration on WGS84 ellipsoid for geographic CRSs. Angular degrees are never treated as linear meters.

R-VERIFY-001 - R-VERIFY-006: Independent verification checks (CRS validity, spatial overlap, grid alignment, physical range, temporal order, provenance) gate model execution. Verification status FAIL halts ungrounded language output.
Sensor-Semantic Band Resolution: Algorithms request semantic roles (RED, GREEN, NIR, SWIR, SAR_CO_POL, SAR_CROSS_POL) rather than hardcoded band indices.
Bi-temporal change requires two temporally ordered observations (t1 < t2). Single image change requests return REQUEST_INPUT.
CDVQA / SECOND License Gate: cdvqa_full_dataset_license_gate = BLOCKED. Switch P4-E02 to LEVIR-CC change description.
LEVIR-CC Provenance: Academic/non-commercial research only (derived from LEVIR-CD). No imagery redistribution. Test set sealed.
Modified Sen1Floods11 (Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.7946594): CC BY 4.0. Authoritative labels represent post-event water extent. Expansion is computed separately as deterministic GIS evidence.
